_comment: The Grub Hub, Osbaldwick (York) — rebrand of Ozzo Grub. Scaffolded from the printed menu. PLACEHOLDERS to fill before go-live: business.legalName / companyNumber / email / domain, address.postcode, stripe.connectedAccountId, and delivery (collection-only for now — needs the exact postcode + areas/fees). Orders cannot be taken until the real Stripe Connect account + platform Stripe secrets are configured in Cloudflare.

business._comment_todo: Registered company + contact email + domain not supplied yet. Left as placeholders so the legal pages fall back gracefully (they use the trading name + phone until these are filled).

address._comment_postcode: Need the venue's exact postcode — it's the delivery radius origin and feeds maps/SEO. Left blank for now (collection-only).

seo.description: The Grub Hub, Osbaldwick (York) — breakfasts, loaded baguette box meals, Irish spice bag, curries, salt & pepper and honey chilli chicken, and wrap boxes. Big flavour, big portions, big value.

_comment_theme: Grub Hub brand on the shared (light) order template: cream background, CHARCOAL primary (the template puts light text on the primary colour, so it must be dark) and honey-gold accent. Fonts left as the platform default (Archivo Black display / DM Sans body), which match the brand's recommended type.

delivery._comment: Collection-only for now. The printed menu offers delivery — to switch it on I need the shop's exact postcode (the radius origin) and the delivery areas/fees, then set enabled:true with a radius or outcode block (see data/shops/_template/config.json).

_comment_serviceFee: Per-order service charge in pence (shown at checkout). serviceFeePlatformPence is the platform's (Lumin Labs') cut taken as the Stripe application_fee; the rest stays with the shop. £1.00 charge = 50p platform + 50p shop. Adjust to taste.
_comment_stripe: PLACEHOLDER — card payments WILL FAIL until the venue's real Stripe Connect acct_… is set here AND the platform Stripe secrets + this shop's Connect webhook are configured in Cloudflare. Orders stay off until then (the build prints a loud warning).

hours._comment: Source: printed menu — Mon & Tue closed; Wed 9am-9pm; Thu 4pm-9pm; Fri & Sat 9am-9pm; Sun 9am-3pm.

_comment_payments: stripeEnabled true but cash options OFF, so the ONLY checkout path is online card — which can't complete until Stripe is wired up. This enforces 'no orders until we accept online payments'. Flip cashOnCollectionEnabled true later if you want to also take cash on collection.

allergens.noticeAtCheckout: For allergens please contact us before ordering.
